Dialogs.Dialog: How is it？ I thought you might like it shorter... Did I guess right？
What do you think of my hair？ I took the plunge and cut it...
Hehe. Short hair is cute, right... Just kidding.
I went with medium-length. I'd like to hear what you think.
I thought about it a lot and ended up at this length... Is it weird？
I thought this length was best. What do you think？
My hair grew, so I tried this. Mama said it's nice... Does it suit me？
I let my hair grow out. I thought it might be nicer and more girly...
How is it？ This hairstyle. I grew it out thinking you'd like it.
Thank you. It really does make me happy to be complimented.
I'm glad. I was wondering what you'd think the whole time.
Really？ Hehe... Oh no, I can't stop grinning.
I see... Okay, I'll keep that in mind.
I see... I shouldn't have done it.
Did I mess up？ What do I do...
Hey, look. I changed my hairstyle, what do you think？
Um, my hairstyle... I changed it, partly for a change of pace.
Hey, you noticed, right？ What do you think？
I'm glad I tried all sorts of things...
Thank you. Is it closer to what you like？
You didn't like it？ Maybe I'll rethink it...
...So this isn't it. It really is hard.
How's this color？ Um... it's a makeover.
I changed my hair color. Compared to before, what do you think？
I changed my hair color. How is it, did it turn out well？
Hey. I changed my hair color a little.
Mama tried to stop me, but I thought it'd suit me... What do you think？
I know I'm being adventurous. So... be honest.
This hair color, of course. Did it surprise you？
Hey. Do these clothes suit me？ They're different from usual, so I can't tell...
Maybe clothes like this are okay once in a while... I wonder？
How are these clothes？ I used a different magazine than usual for ideas.
▲主人公＊▲. Tell me what you think of these clothes？ I went for an elegant look.
I wonder if neat, simple fashion suits me... What do you think？
What do you think of clothes like this？ The theme is "elegant girl"... Just kidding.
I wanted to change my vibe a bit. Don't you think these clothes are cute？
I tried wearing something different from usual... Do you like cute clothes like this？
I tried changing my look. Did it come out cute？
I went with casual clothes. Is this your type？
Did my image change？ In clothes like this, do I look more active？
How's this outfit？ I went casual for a different vibe than usual.
This is my very best... Does it make your heart race？
Um, these clothes... are they s-sexy, do you think？
I'm a little worried about where you're looking, but... are you happy when I wear clothes like this？
You like this？ I'll remember that.
I'm so happy... I was nervous until I showed you.
Thank you for your honest opinion. *Phew*
I see. Then this is out. ...Fashion is hard.
Really？ Seems I still don't understand you...
Sorry. If you're not interested, it's fine.
So you're not interested. That might be more of a shock than being told it doesn't suit me...
I agonized over what to choose, and now I feel kind of stupid...
It's pointless if you're not happy with it...
...I don't think that kind of attitude is good. ...Geez.
My clothes... are they too plain？
I always try to dress elegantly. What do you think？
Hey, what kind of clothes do you like？ Today's elegant look？
It's all the same to me
I like cute outfits like this... but I'd like to hear your opinion.
What do you think of these clothes？ Is cute your taste？
I try to dress cute, but aren't you getting tired of it？
I think casual clothes suit me, but maybe not？
I like it as it is
They're easy to move in, so I wear clothes like this... but what do you think？
Maybe I should try a different style？ Something besides casual might be nice.
Okay. If you like it, that's good enough. ...No, that's what I want. Just kidding.
Really？ I'm happy, but if you'd like something different, tell me, okay？
I see... Then I'll stick with this style.
Ah... okay. I'll think about it next time I go shopping.
I knew it... I had a feeling it wasn't right.
I see... Okay, look forward to next time.
Mm... I wanted a clearer opinion...
I want you to really look at me...
Geez, that doesn't tell me anything.
